title: Linear-Time Context Compression with State-Space Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.33006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) impose substantial computation and memory costs as context sizes increase, motivating methods that compress a context into a shorter representation before inference. Existing soft-prompt compression methods typically use the same Transformer backbone as used in the target model, where producing the compressed representation leads to significant latency overheads. This restricts them to the offline setting where context is compressed once and then reused across many queries. We propose the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model (SSM) that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, producing a representation on which we condition a frozen target LLM. The SSM is trained by distillation, matching the next-token logit distribution from the LLM ingesting the full context (as teacher) to the same LLM ingesting the compressed

translated_title: 基于状态空间编码的线性时间上下文压缩
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLM）随着上下文长度的增加会带来巨大的计算和内存开销，这促使人们研究在推理前将上下文压缩为更短表示的方法。现有的软提示压缩方法通常使用与目标模型相同的Transformer骨干网络，导致生成压缩表示时产生显著的延迟开销，这限制了它们只能应用于离线场景——即上下文只需压缩一次然后在多次查询中重复使用。我们提出了Boa Compressor（蟒蛇压缩器），这是一种即插即用的在线上下文压缩器，它基于Mamba状态空间模型（SSM）构建，能够在单次线性时间遍历中编码任意长度的上下文，生成的表示用于条件化一个冻结的目标LLM。该SSM通过蒸馏方式训练，使摄入完整上下文的LLM（作为教师）的下一个词logit分布与摄入压缩上下文的同一LLM（作为学生）相匹配。
tldr: 提出了基于Mamba状态空间模型的Boa Compressor，一种即插即用的在线上下文压缩器，能以线性时间单次遍历编码任意长度上下文并条件化冻结的目标LLM，突破了现有Transformer压缩方法延迟高、仅适用于离线场景的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Boa Compressor, a plug-and-play online context compressor built on a Mamba state-space model that encodes arbitrary-length context in a single linear-time pass, overcoming the latency overhead and offline-only limitation of existing Transformer-based soft-prompt compression methods.
